findings.summary: D1: T24 Step 1 requires recording whether a pull_request_review check attaches to the PR head; the input contains no attachment result, leaving the required trigger acceptance check unverified.
D2: T24 Step 2 requires live acceptance cases with run URLs and conclusions, including run_attempt > 1 after Gemini and Codex events; the diff supplies fixture tests but no live acceptance records.

D3: T24 Step 3 requires approved activation, readback, and a timestamped review-gate activation entry; the input provides no activation evidence or activation-file change, so the declared rollout task remains incomplete.

D4: T24 specifies operator acceptance and activation work; the diff additionally changes Gemini substitution eligibility to identify runs by workflow path and extends the API adapter and tests, a useful implementation repair not specified by that task.
